meta.name: debugging
meta.description: MUST USE for any real runtime debugging across ANY language or binary — crashes, silent failures, wrong responses, stuck processes, memory leaks, async misbehavior, unexplained timing, reverse engineering. Runs a hypothesis-driven loop: form ≥3 hypotheses, investigate in parallel, after 2 failed rounds spawn Oracles from orthogonal angles, confirm root cause, lock with a failing test, fix minimally, QA by actually USING the system, scrub artifacts. The actual HOW lives in `references/` — READ THEM. Triggers: 'debug this', 'why is X not working', 'hanging', 'attach a debugger', 'reverse engineer', 'pwndbg', 'gdb', 'lldb', 'node inspect', 'tsx debug', 'pdb', 'dlv', 'delve', 'rust-gdb', 'set a breakpoint', 'context window exploded', 'why is the response empty', 'attach the debugger', 'debug it', 'why is this happening', 'trace this bug', 'reproduce and fix', 'silent failure', 'HTTP 200 but empty', 'why did it stop', 'inspect the binary', 'reverse engineering', 'playwright'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline_en: Diagnose and fix runtime issues in any language or binary
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to locate and fix subtle bugs in code

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按假设驱动循环调试：先形成至少3个假设，并行调查；若两轮失败，从不同角度生成“预言”来定位根因；确认后用失败测试锁定，最小化修复，最后实际使用系统做质量检查并清理痕迹。
howto.when: 当你描述程序崩溃、静默失败、挂起、内存泄漏等运行时问题，或要求“调试这个”、“为什么X不工作”、“附加调试器”等时触发。

say.text: 调试这个 Python 脚本，它运行后没有输出。
say.note: Claude 会读取运行时参考并启动调试循环。

say.text: 为什么我的 Node.js 服务返回空响应？
say.note: Claude 会检查 Node 运行时参考，并行调查假设。

say.text: 帮我逆向分析这个二进制文件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude runs a hypothesis-driven debug loop: forms at least 3 hypotheses, investigates in parallel; after 2 failed rounds spawns Oracles from orthogonal angles; confirms root cause, locks with a failing test, fixes minimally, QA by actually using the system, and scrubs artifacts.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you describe runtime issues like crashes, silent failures, hangs, memory leaks, or say 'debug this', 'why is X not working', 'attach a debugger', etc.

say_en.text: Debug this Python script that produces no output.
say_en.note: Claude reads the runtime reference and starts the debug loop.

say_en.text: Why does my Node.js service return empty responses?
say_en.note: Claude checks Node runtime reference and investigates hypotheses in parallel.

say_en.text: Reverse engineer this binary for me.
say_en.note: Claude uses Ghidra and other tools for static and dynamic analysis.
